missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Солнце' is the neuter nominative subject of 'светит'. 'Ярко' is the adverb describing how it shines, a classic weather sentence.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Солнце' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю'; for neuter nouns the accusative looks identical to the nominative. 'Утреннее' is the agreeing neuter adjective.
Strategic focus: Dative with 'к'. 'Солнцу' is the dative form after 'к', marking the direction the flowers reach toward. A natural image for the dative ending.
Strategic focus: Genitive with 'без'. 'Солнца' is genitive after 'без', expressing absence. 'Растениям' is the dative experiencer, a useful conditional-feeling pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of agent. 'Солнцем' is the instrumental case marking what lights the Earth in this passive construction. A clean model for the neuter instrumental ending.

missions.phrase: Мы говорили о солнце и звёздах.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О солнце' uses the prepositional form 'солнце' after 'о'; for this neuter noun the prepositional matches the base form. Joined to 'звёздах' by 'и'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'На солнце' uses the prepositional form after 'на' to mean in the sunshine. 'Жарко' is the impersonal weather predicate, a very common phrase.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Солнце' is the neuter nominative subject of 'скрылось', which agrees in neuter gender. 'За облаками' is the instrumental plural showing where it hid.

missions.phrase: Дети играли под солнцем весь день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'под'. 'Солнцем' is instrumental after 'под', describing the location below the sun. 'Весь день' gives the accusative span of time.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Солнце' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Высоко' is the adverb of position, and 'в небе' is the prepositional place, a calm descriptive line.
